notes.title: Pairs & Perils - v1.2.0 - The Exiled Update (Free Content Update)
notes.notes:
🛡️ The Exiled Update is Here! 🛡️

Our latest free content update has just landed — and it’s packed with new ways to build, battle, and brag! Here’s what’s new in Pairs & Perils:


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174019/6fe7e1629b104de73e7bae2c6fa46dae034c7f7f.png"]


✨ New Hero: The Lancer  
A fearless frontline warrior joins the fight! Pierce through enemies with precision and new tactics.

🃏 5 New Cards  
Expand your strategic options with fresh card mechanics and powerful synergies.

🎒 5 New Items  
Discover unique relics and gear up for your dungeon runs like never before.

🏆 11 New Achievements  
Think you've mastered the game? Try completing these new challenges:


Sloth – Rest 25 times  


Shredder – Remove 25 cards from your deck  


Prospector – Open 30 card chests  


Relic Hunter – Open 30 item backpacks  


Gambler – Reroll 50 times  


Alliance – Win a run with only Ally cards  


Genius – Match 6 pairs in a row  


Battle Thirst – Skip all non-battle encounters in one run  


Spender – Spend 500 gold  


+ 2 more hidden achievements for you to discover!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174019/66bbabbfd69b29e6c407b2bb9d89364cdf256279.png"]

Whether you’re a veteran or coming back for another run, there’s never been a better time to test your memory and your mettle.

⚔️ Good luck, and may your matches be flawless!

notes.title: Pairs & Perils - 🏛️ The Legion’s Oath Update
notes.notes:
Adventurers, your journey through the perils of memory and combat is about to get even more thrilling! 

The Legion’s Oath marks the first free content update for Pairs & Perils, introducing new heroes, cards, items, and a fearsome new boss. Along with balance tweaks and quality-of-life improvements, this update enhances your dungeon-crawling, card-matching experience.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174019/118892e6f980d59130c90294945d6c13daf80f8a.png

✨ New Additions  

 🛡️ 3 New Heroes – Expand your roster with fresh faces, each bringing unique skills to the battlefield.  
 🃏 5 New Cards – More strategic possibilities to experiment with!  
 🔮 5 New Items – Strengthen your build with powerful new relics.  
 💀 1 New Boss Battle – A challenging new foe awaits those brave enough to face them.
 🏆 13 New Achievements – More ways to test your skill and earn rewards.  
 🌟 New Map Encounter: Free Random Item – A lucky chance for adventurers to gain an edge!  


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174019/c780d7bb819a8a4f585379f16c3cd2ea7d94f446.png

⚖️ Balance Adjustments  

 Knight (Card): Gains Fury against debuffed targets instead of just Atrophy.  
 Alchemist (Hero): HP reduced from 60 → 50.  
 Golem (Enemy): HP increased from 6 → 8; Counter reduced from 6 → 5.  
 Assassin (Card): Rarity changed from Rare → Common.  
 Warrior (Card): Rarity changed from Common → Rare.  
 Rebalanced Easy, Normal, and Hard difficulty modes for a more refined experience.  
 Adjusted starting deck randomization for better consistency.  


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174019/93a4ca8a709cb9ed114ec0a021b8229bafd010cd.png

🔄 Changes & QoL Improvements  

 Card Upgrades can now be accessed at the Rest Site alongside Heal and Remove Card options. No more searching for a specific map encounter!  
 Hero Unlock Conditions are now visible in the Hero selection screen—no more guesswork!  


This is just the beginning! We’re excited to continue refining and expanding Pairs & Perils with more content and updates in the future. 

If you’ve been enjoying your adventure, please take a moment to leave a review! Your feedback helps us grow and bring even more thrilling content to the game. 🖤  

Happy matching ⚔️✨  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3179860/Pairs__Perils/

notes.title: Pairs & Perils - Day 1 - Bug Fixes & Balance Update
notes.notes:
Hey Heroes!

We listened to your feedback and investigated some bugs, we have a post launch update, that focuses on difficulties, quest balances and bug fixes. 

Balance

Cards

Lullaby: Increased Sleep effect from 2 → 3.
Bard (Upgraded): Reduced Sleep effect from 3 → 2.
Vampirize (Upgraded): Adjusted Fangs effect from 2 random Ally cards → 3 Fangs to 1 random Ally card.

Items

Money Box: Fury effect now capped at Max 3 Fury (previously uncapped).

Enemies

Dark Paladin:
  
  Attack reduced from 2 → 0.
  Counter reduced from 4 → 3.


Quests

Never Saw That Coming: Updated requirement from "One shot an enemy" → "One shot an enemy with 5 or more Health."
Quick Thinking: Increased challenge from "Win a battle without taking damage" → "Win 4 battles without taking damage in a single run."
Remembrance: Increased match requirement from "Match 3 pairs in succession" → 4 pairs.
Memorizer: Increased match requirement from "Match 4 pairs in succession" → 5 pairs.
Tightwad: Increased gold requirement from "Accumulate 50 gold" → 70 gold.

Difficulty

Hard: Traps now gain +1 attack on hard battles.
Dungeon Master:
  
  +1 additional trap in every battle.
  Traps gain +1 attack on hard battles.
  Traps that apply debuffs now appear in hard battles.
  Effects applied to cards facing down are no longer displayed.
  Hero gains mana only on correct card combinations.
  

Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where the boss would not appear when continuing from a previous save.
Buff removal now properly removes the card's extra damage.
Debuff removal now properly removes the card's negative damage.
Fixed an issue where the shield effect did not block incoming damage.
Resolved a visual bug where selected cards would appear on top of the deck and graveyard screens.
Empower no longer upgrades itself unintentionally.
Fixed a bug where enemies could attack even if Sleep was applied.

Quality of Life (QoL)

Added text feedback for invalid skill usage (e.g., no mana, wrong turn, not in battle, or no traps available with Alchemist).
Updated descriptions for Hard and Dungeon Master difficulty modes for clarity.


Enjoy the update and happy pairing!

❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

If you enjoyed Pairs & Perils, please consider writing us a review on Steam, as this helps us immensely in reaching new players, share your thoughts and ideas, we value your reviews a lot, and shape the game depending on it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3179860/Pairs__Perils/

notes.title: Major Demo Update - Card Effects & Enemies
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Based on the feedback you’ve been providing, we made a huge update to the demo. Thank you for sharing your thoughts with us and please let us know what you think about this new version!

Here are the main things that were added / changed:

 You can now build your deck within a run
 Cards have effects besides just dealing damage 
 Battle encounters with multiple enemies
 New enemies
 Pretty much every item got reworked, now there are no longer effects based on probability
 Color blind options for cards


You now start with 5 cards, which can be rerolled before beginning the run. You can acquire more cards by purchasing them at the merchant.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174019/8fd715c022eb15a450f9f4907560c2b294079ce4.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174019/4e2c63532cbf1d3d27de95355a3ac07efecc4791.png

By adding multiple enemies and card effects, a new layer of strategy was added to the game, where you can’t just mindlessly keep turning cards until you get a match. You have to think what effects you want to trigger and who you want to defeat first.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174019/1f037696a5be83565d7c028aed3a883b048b56e7.png

We also heard your complaints about the game being too RNG heavy, so based on that and in other successful games in the genre, we decided to remove every luck-based effect, so you can strategize better.

We changed the card background colors so they won’t be too similar to one another and also added names to them, so you can now find their pair by looking either at their bg color, or name, or portrait. You can also go to the settings and change the card color mode to one of those: deuteranopia; protanopia; tritanopia.

In the near future we will add more ways of getting healed, acquire / remove cards and maybe upgrade them. Also more toggles to the settings for things like bloom, film grain and screenshake.

Don’t forget to wishlist the game and share your feedback with us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3179860/Pairs__Perils/

Thank you for your time and have fun!
Angelo

notes.title: Plans for the Full Release
notes.notes:
Hi all!

First of all, thank you for playing the demo and leaving your review in the feedback form! I’ve read all of it and had a few ideas that I would like to share with you!

Although not final, you can get a glimpse of what I have in mind for the full release version:

Features
There are four major points that most of you asked for, which are:

 Cards triggering effects when combined
 Deck-building
 More events than just battles and shops
 Multiple enemies at once


The idea is, you start a new run with just a small deck, which can have more cards added to it by accessing certain events. Each combination (ally card + weapon card) will have its own effect. For example, you are fighting 3 enemies at once, so you pair the Bard with his Lute and it boosts the damage of your next attack. Then, you match the Barbarian with the Warhammer, so he receives an attack bonus and triggers his own effect, which deals damage to all enemies in the table, crushing them all.

You could have a more offensive deck or maybe you would like to have more visibility of the cards in the battlefield. So you add a mage to your deck, which gives information of the nearby cards, or a hunter which reveals random traps and so on.

More than just battles and shop events, there would be events to heal your hero, upgrade your cards and acquire new ones. We are also considering adding a map similar to other roguelike deckbuilding games, to give you more freedom and letting you decide your own path.

Fighting multiple enemies at once would add another layer of strategy, so you would have to choose which one to defeat first.

We are also considering adding reserve card slots, where you can keep up to two cards to be used later in the fight, so you don’t have to rely 100% on memory every time.

Accessibility and QoL
We will be adding more options to improve the gameplay experience, some of them are:

 Speed up animations
 Enable / disable grain effect
 Enable / disable bloom effect
 Better distinction between card colors
 Colorblind options
 Better HUD information
 Interactive tutorial


We’ll also add many more items, enemies and heroes and balance the current ones to give you a better experience!

Those are our current plans for the future. Feel free to drop your thoughts in the comments below and give us more suggestions. We’ll take everything into consideration!

In case you haven't already, don't forget to wishlist the game to be notified when it releases!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3179860/Pairs__Perils/

Thank you and have a great week!
Ang
